set.7.text: Waves roll in and break over the black rocks, spray rising and falling. The camera holds still.
The steam locomotive moves steadily across the viaduct, steam drifting back in the wind. The camera holds still.
Espresso streams steadily into the glass cup and the crema rises. The camera holds still.
Rain falls on the fern, drops hit the frond and run down the curl. The camera holds still.
